drafts.body: Marcus - I said I would get you the final settlement statement by Tuesday and I did not. It is attached now. Apologies for the lag. Anything else you need from the file, tell me and I will pull it today.

Priya - back in December you asked what the Hargrove place actually went for and I never circled back. It closed at $412,000 on 2026-01-22. [source: MLS closed sales for 37172, pulled 2026-08-29] Sorry that took eight months.

Dana - eight years in the Maple Ridge house as of June. No agenda here: if a move is anywhere on your mind for next year, I would rather hear it early than late. And if it is not, that is a fine answer too.

drafts.earned_moment: closed her second transaction with us 2015-03-30 and sent the Bells our way in 2024 without being asked
drafts.body: Priya - separate note. You sent the Bells our way last year and I never properly thanked you for it. If you are ever willing to write two lines about what working together was like, I would be grateful. No rush and no hard feelings if you would rather not.
